name: @sparq-org/sparq
description: RDF/JS interface to the sparq SPARQL engine (Rust → WebAssembly): an in-memory, dictionary-encoded RDF store with SELECT/ASK and SPARQL Update.

scripts._copy:wasm: rm -rf wasm && mkdir wasm && cp ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm.js ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm.d.ts ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm_bg.wasm ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts wasm/
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --features shacl,jsonld,serialize-rdf,scs,canon,explain-json,native-ttl,bytes-ingest,forms --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _copy:wasm
scripts.build:wasm:lean: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _copy:wasm
scripts.build:wasm:node: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-wasm --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --profile release-wasm --features shacl,jsonld,serialize-rdf,scs,canon,explain-json,native-ttl,bytes-ingest,forms --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _copy:wasm:node
scripts.build:reason-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-reason-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --features explain --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:node && npm run build:ts
scripts.prepack:skills: rm -rf skills AGENTS.md && cp -R ../skills skills && cp ../AGENTS.md AGENTS.md
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run prepack:skills
